accessibility.highContrastSelection: Make the selection stand out more
accessibility.highContrastSelectionHint: A thicker, higher-contrast outline and fill around the selected cells.
accessibility.reduceMotionHint: Turns off animations and smooth scrolling in the app.
edit.autoComplete: Suggest the rest of an entry from the column
edit.autoCompleteHint: AutoComplete fills in a match from the cells above as you type.
edit.autoFlashFill: Offer Flash Fill as you type
edit.autoFlashFillHint: After a few examples that follow a pattern, offer to fill the rest of the column.
edit.editInCellHint: Off: F2 and double-clicking edit in the formula bar.
edit.enterMove: After pressing Enter, move the selection
edit.extendLists: Carry a list’s formats and formulas onto new rows
edit.extendListsHint: Typing under a list formats the new cell like the rows above, and fills in formulas the list repeats.
edit.fillHandle: Use the fill handle, and drag cells to move or copy them
edit.fillOptionsButton: Show the Auto Fill Options button after filling
edit.fixedDecimal: Put in a decimal point automatically
edit.fixedDecimalHint: Whole numbers typed without a point get these places: 1234 becomes 12.34.
edit.fixedDecimalPlacesHint: A negative number adds zeros instead: −2 makes 5 into 500.
edit.longOperationAlert: Ask before a command that changes very many cells
edit.overwriteAlert: Ask before a drag replaces cells that hold data
edit.pasteOptionsButton: Show the Paste Options button after pasting
formulas.calcAutoNoTable: Automatically, but for data tables (F9 updates them)
formulas.errorCheckingEnabled: Check for errors in the background
formulas.iterate: Allow circular references, calculated by iteration
formulas.iterateHint: Each round recalculates the circle until no value moves by more than the largest change.
formulas.newCalcModeHint: Your choice for workbooks you create; a workbook you open keeps its own.
formulas.savedWith: Saved with “{name}”, and the same for everyone who opens it.
formulas.savedWithThisWorkbook: Saved with “this workbook”, and the same for everyone who opens it.
general.fontHint: The Normal style of a new workbook, used by every cell not formatted otherwise.
general.newViewHint: Also used for sheets added to any workbook.
general.startScreen: Show the start screen when the app opens
general.startScreenHint: Your spreadsheets and templates. Off: the app opens straight onto a new, blank workbook.
general.userName: Name shown on your comments and changes
general.userNameHint: Leave blank to use your Puter account name.
general.userNameHintAccount: Leave blank to use your Puter account name, {account}.
keyboard.alreadyThis: Already a shortcut for this command.
keyboard.note: Shortcuts you add work on the sheet and in the menus, and the menus show them. A shortcut must use Ctrl, ⌘, Alt or Option, or be a function key.
keyboard.takenFrom: {count, plural, one {Now runs {commands}. Assigning takes it from it.} other {Now runs {commands}. Assigning takes it from them.}}
noMatch: No option matches. Try another word.
privacy.offerAiFeaturesHint: The AI assistant, Write a formula with AI and the AI() function send the cells and words you give them to Puter’s AI service. Off: they are hidden and nothing is sent.
proofing.autoCorrectNote: AutoCorrect fixes common typing slips and expands shorthand as you type.
quickAccess.below: Show the toolbar below the ribbon
quickAccess.labels: Show command names beside their icons
quickAccess.tip: Tip: right-click any ribbon button and choose Add to Quick Access Toolbar.
ribbon.note: Built-in groups stay as they are; put any command in a group of your own, on any tab. Space shows or hides the selected tab.
save.autoSaveHint: Saves your changes a moment after you make them. The switch beside the title turns it off for this device.
save.draftDelay: Keep a recovery copy of unsaved edits in this browser
save.draftDelayHint: If the tab closes or the connection drops before a save, the edits come back from this copy.
sections.accessibilityAbout: Making the selection easier to see, and the screen calmer.
sections.editAbout: Typing into cells, moving the selection, and working with the fill handle.
sections.formulasAbout: When formulas calculate, and which problems error checking points out.
sections.generalAbout: How the app starts, what a new workbook looks like, and your name on comments.
sections.keyboardAbout: Give any command keys of its own, or free keys for something else.
sections.privacyAbout: Whether features that send your data to an AI service are offered.
sections.quickAccessAbout: The commands beside the title, always one click away.
sections.ribbonAbout: Show, hide, rename and reorder tabs, and build tabs and groups of your own.
sections.saveAbout: Saving to Puter as you work, and the recovery copy kept in this browser.
sections.viewAbout: What the window shows around the sheet, and how comments and objects appear.
view.commentIndicators: For cells with comments or notes, show
view.showHeadersHint: Each sheet keeps its own setting (View ▸ Row and column headers).
view.showObjects: Charts, pictures, shapes and text boxes
